headline: Ramayana Day 19: ₹12.70 Cr India nett
lede: 13:00 IST: Ramayana Day 19: ₹12.70 Cr India nett
body:
## 13:00 IST — Occupancy and bookings

Through Day 19 the desk has Ramayana at ₹968.2 Cr India nett, ₹1,141.7 Cr India gross, ₹563.0 Cr overseas and ₹1,704.7 Cr worldwide. Adding the day-wise nett rows gives ₹955.45 Cr, which is a different series from that lifetime nett, so the two are not combined. Behind it on the daily chart, O.M Operation Mole at ₹6.20 Cr and Aakasamlo Oka Tara at ₹3.20 Cr. This day's overseas figure is not in, so it is not used to move the worldwide total.

Trade coverage is still led by Ramayana. The Indian Express is citing about ₹1,700.0 Cr. The desk keeps ₹968.2 Cr India nett and ₹1,704.7 Cr worldwide, and does not blend those reports into its own total. No producer-certified total is included.

editions.lede: Ramayana on Day 19 (Tuesday, 24 November 2026) is at ₹12.70 Cr India nett and ₹15.15 Cr India gross, -64.3% from Day 18's ₹35.60 Cr. The board has 15,696 shows at 17% occupancy. Trade notes mention advance bookings, but no separate booking total is published here. The day is still open, so this is not the final figure.
